column1: # workspaces components: kind  name  key  description  flags (see lib/components.sh)
# Rows are "key<TAB>state<TAB>type<TAB>root<TAB>display". Enter prints the key, which `workspace pick` opens.
mode    all         -          predefined sessions, the family's open sessions, recent directories  default
mode    open        -          the family's open sessions                                    -
mode    recent      -          recent directories without a session                          -
action  open        alt-enter  open the workspace here (workspace open)                      become
action  reset       alt-R      kill the open sessions and build them again from their layout  confirm,reload
action  kill        alt-x      kill the open sessions (their clients stay in the family)    confirm,reload
action  forget      alt-d      drop the recent directories from the list                     notify,reload
action  copy        ctrl-y     copy the keys (session names, directories)                    silent,builtin
